abstract: An unusual case of bilateral Krukenberg tumor with foci of yolk sac tumor (YST) differentiation occurring in a 50-year-old patient is reported. The primary tumor was in the gastric antrum, and it showed morphology of poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma with diffuse and solid growth pattern. A component of typical YST was not found in the gastric primary and lymph node metastases, although some cells in these locations were positive for alpha-fetoprotein. In the ovarian metastases, YST element showed microcystic/reticular and solid patterns, whereas the adenocarcinoma component was of diffuse type with signet ring cells and with some undifferentiated areas. The case represents further example of the somatic cell-derived tumor with focal germ cell-type differentiation and the first report of YST differentiation in Krukenberg tumor.
abstract_ja: 50歳患者で、胃前庭部に原発した低分化型腺癌の両側クルーケンベルグ腫瘍を報告する。卵黄嚢腫瘍（YST）分化の巣を伴っていた。原発巣は、びまん性かつ充実性の増殖パターンを示す低分化型腺癌の形態を示していた。胃原発巣とリンパ節転移では典型的なYST成分は認められなかったが、これら部位の一部の細胞はαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。卵巣転移では、YST成分が微小嚢胞/網状および充実性パターンを示し、腺癌成分は印環細胞と一部未分化な領域を伴うびまん性型であった。本症例は、胚細胞型分化を巣状に示す体細胞由来腫瘍のさらなる例であり、クルーケンベルグ腫瘍でYST分化が認められた初の報告である。
